facts.text: GymEnv is the molmospaces gymnasium environment class; it subclasses gymnasium.Env
GymEnv wraps a MolmoSpaces task sampler and keeps the current episode's task on env.task
The env id namespace is MolmoSpaces
An environment id is NAMESPACE/<ConfigName>-v<version>
The upstream gym compatibility guide builds the Franka pick environment with the id MolmoSpaces/FrankaPickDroidDataGenConfig-v0
FrankaPickDroidDataGenConfig is registered in the data generation config registry
GymEnv deliberately declares no action_space: actions are dicts keyed by move group (arm, gripper, etc.)
GymEnv deliberately declares no observation_space: observations are list[dict], one per batch element
The gym compatibility guide states observations are list[dict], one per batch element, and the key set can change between resets
Only n_batch == 1 is supported; a larger batch is refused
The only reset options are house_index and force_advance_scene
reset(seed, options) samples a new task and returns task.reset()
reset closes the previous task before sampling the next one
step delegates to the current task's step with the action dict
A reset with a seed calls task_sampler.seed_task_sampling(seed)
seed_task_sampling seeds random, numpy and torch globally
The PickBaseConfig control timestep is 2.0 ms and its task horizon is 500 steps
A task is truncated when episode_step_count reaches the task horizon
A task step returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated and info
The task info carries cumulative_reward and num_steps_taken per batch element
RobotJointPositionSensor returns the robot joint positions as a dict keyed by move group
The pick task sensor suite registers the qpos sensor with uuid qpos and max_joints 9
Franka's initial qpos has 7 arm joints and 2 gripper joints
register_configs registers every config with entry point molmo_spaces.tasks.gym_env:GymEnv and max_episode_steps None
Registration passes order_enforce=False so gymnasium.make returns the GymEnv itself
render returns an RGB array and does not require render_mode to be set
close closes the current task and closes the sampler only when the env built it
A reset samples an episode and can load a scene and compile a MuJoCo model, which takes seconds

determinism.notes: the fake's reset re-seeds its own random.Random from the reset seed, so one seed and one action sequence repeat its trajectory; upstream seeds Python's random, numpy and torch globally instead (task_sampler.py:428-431), so the two are not expected to agree

fidelity.engine: molmo_spaces:GymEnv (fake backend: analytic episode model; upstream would be MuJoCo)
gaps: kinematic/analytic wrapper only: the fake samples an episode and advances one 2 ms control step per tick (PickBaseConfig ctrl_dt_ms, base_pick_config.py:39); it models no MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics, contacts, gripper geometry, actuators, sensors or noise

the observation is reduced to the qpos sensor of one batch element: arm 7 joints and gripper 2 joints (robot_configs.py:150-153); upstream also returns qvel, robot_base_pose, env_states, task_info, camera frames, TCP pose, object poses and action sensors, and the key set can change between resets
actions are accepted as an open dict keyed by move group; the fake applies arm and gripper joint positions but does not model the controller, contact or object interaction the real task uses
no rendering: render() is not served by this package and no RGB frame is produced
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and only commands advance simulated time, one control step per tick
no snapshot or restore: GymEnv exposes no get_state/set_state, so determinism is seeded, not exact
the fake was never compared with a real MuJoCo run, no physical device is modelled, and the model was not validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
